Subject guide

Live music lessons and performance programs

Find a lesson that matches your experience and the skill you want to practise. Check the equipment, preparation, and schedule before booking.

Explore current programs↗

Get specific about what you want to practise

Music theory, songwriting, an instrument, acting, and speaking on stage ask for different kinds of practice. Decide what you want to work on first. Then read the program outcomes and level. A focused goal makes it easier to tell whether a broad program or a short lesson is the right fit.

Read the provider’s background and portfolio

A provider’s profile brings together their experience, skills, languages, and work they have chosen to share. Where a portfolio includes audio or video, use it to understand their approach and area of practice. A familiar style can be helpful, but the program description still needs to explain what you will learn.

Prepare the space as well as the equipment

Check whether you need an instrument, written material, or particular equipment. For live online sessions, think about a space where you can hear and participate clearly. In-person programs have their own venue and material requirements. Ask about anything that could affect your ability to take part.

Plan your practice time

A single session may suit a specific question. A series can leave room for practice between meetings. Look at every session in the schedule and plan around the work you can realistically do. The program discussion and private messages provide separate ways to ask a follow-up question where appropriate.

Before you choose

A few things to check

  • The skill and starting level
  • Instrument or equipment needs
  • Your practice schedule
  • Provider portfolio and language

Current programs, prices, and dates are available in the app.

Choosing your program

Good questions
to ask.

Can I join as a complete beginner?

Choose a program marked beginner and read its requirements. Some programs may still expect an instrument or basic preparation.

Should I book one lesson or a series?

Choose based on the program outcomes and the time you can commit to practice. Check the full schedule to understand exactly what the selected booking includes.
